'''Mike Mooney''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Mountain View Grand Slam]] on 19 February 2000 with [[ISB Operations / Empire's Sinister Agents|Undercover ISB Space]], according to Alfred Dong's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d283">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-26-mt-view-california-2-19d283/ mt-view-california-2-19], DeckTech (Alfred "ThaBraHmaBuL" Dong, 26 February 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-02-26-mt-view-california-2-19d283/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
